","^The rider wears a rust-red scarf and sits on a drum of oil with one boot up on the rim. She waves you over without getting up, as though she were calling a dog. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard","/#","
","^Kaplan wants the man at the north bend gone. He says the man slows the road, and a slow road feeds nobody. Ain wants him gone too, and Ain doesn't give reasons. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^Kaplan says do it clean. Move him on, and don't leave him in a ditch, because Kaplan won't pay for a body. He pays ","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},"out","/ev","^ M for a man who walks away. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^She spits over the rim of the drum and doesn't wait to hear what you say.","
",{"->":"road"},null],"shut":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"kiln_shut","re":true},"^The rider on the oil drum looks you over and doesn't wave. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard","/#","
","^Ain read a page with your name at the bottom of it. It says Kiln strips the dead. Kaplan sends nothing to a hand that signed a page like that. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^Ride out to the bend if you like. Kiln will remember which side your hand was on when you did. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^She puts her back to you and goes on polishing the stock of her rifle.","

","^The man sits on an ammunition box where the bend narrows. A grey scarf is wound twice round his neck, and a tin cup hangs from his belt. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^He lifts a hand, and you stop. He walks the length of your truck bed and looks closely at the gun mount.","
","^Show me your pins. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He crouches and puts a thumb on each pin one after another. He nods and lets you go on. Then he looks at the wall of the bend, where Emil Kessel's wreck lies burnt against the rock.","
","^Emil Kessel went off here last winter. His swivel slid on the curve and the gun came round into his cab. I was the one who found him. It had one pin, and a gun on one pin will do that on a bad bend. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^So I sit here and look at the pins. A driver with a single pin gets a choice from me. A second pin costs only a little at the Salvage Yard, and I pay it myself when the driver can't. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^The patch of a Scrapjaw outrider has been cut from the sleeve of his coat, but the stitches are still there.","
","^I rode for Scrapjaw once. I used to tell the drivers we robbed what to buy, so they wouldn't be robbed twice. Rook didn't like that, and Ain liked it less. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^Soldiers came up this bend after Emil with a clerk. They wrote the wreck down. They never wrote me down, and I'm the one who stayed. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
",{"->":"road"},null],"rise":["^You leave the truck at the foot of the bend and climb the loose rock above the narrow corner. A man can lie flat there and see the whole shelf. ","#","^place: The rise above the bend","/#","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"saw_rise","re":true},"ev","str","^bendRise","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The light goes red and long. A cart comes up the north road with a Nose sergeant and a pair of soldiers on the board.","
","^They carry a crate into the rocks above the narrowest part of the corner and prop its lid open. Army rifles lie inside it, wrapped in fresh grease paper.","
","^The sergeant drops a bundle of red cloth on top of the rifles. He walks the line of the drop with his eyes, from the crate to the road and back. Then the cart goes down the way it came.","
",{"->":"rise.crate"},{"->":"rise.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You lie in the dust until the light goes. You see a cart, a great deal of rock and a lizard. Nothing else makes sense to you.","
","^At the foot of the bend a soldier leans on your truck and writes a line in a small book.","
","^A driver on the rise at dusk. Remember that, because I will. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"road"},{"->":"rise.15"},null]}],"nop","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"scarf","re":true},"^The cloth is new and stiff. It has never been worn. You fold it inside your coat and leave the lid exactly as it was.","
",{"->":"road"},null],"c-1":["

Ash watches you come all the way up the shelf. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^You tell him the post wants the bend clear. You tell him the next men to come will carry rifles and not words.","
","ev","str","^toughness","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You park the truck across the road and stand in front of it with your hands open and your feet apart. Ash looks at your shoulders for a long time. Then he looks at the road.","
","^He folds his scarf, packs the tin cup into his coat and stands up from the box.","
","^Tell Silver it's a public road. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He walks off up the bend and doesn't look back.","

",{"->":".^.^.^.21"},null]}],"nop","
","^At dusk a Nose truck takes the bend with its gun on a single pin. Nobody stops it to ask.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.32"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You park the truck across the road and stand in front of it. Ash doesn't so much as blink.","
","^A Nose truck with a single pin comes up behind you, and its driver leans on the horn. Ash takes his eyes off you, walks to the other truck and crouches by its mount as though you weren't there.","
","^Silver hears of it by dusk. A pair of soldiers who don't talk walk up the bend, and Ash comes down it between them.","
","^Silver pays nothing and calls it excuses. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^At dusk a Nose truck takes the bend with its gun on a single pin. Nobody stops it to ask.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.32"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"kaplan_job":["ev","str","^kiln","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You ride to the bend and tell Ash what Kaplan sent. Ash listens with his eyes on the wall. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You tell him Kaplan asked for him to be left alive, and Ain asked for nothing of the kind. You tell him which man will send the next rider.","
","^Kaplan was always the careful one. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He says he'll leave on his own legs, and Ain will hear he was driven out. He packs his tin cup. He doesn't take the road toward Kiln.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A Kiln rider counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},"out","/ev","^ M into your hand at the Yard gate. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^By the end of the week a pair of riders sit where Ash sat. They don't ask to see pins. They ask to see your cargo.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You say what Kaplan said, and you say it badly. Ash laughs once, short and dry.","
","^Kaplan sends a message and Ain sends the riders. Which one did you think was coming? ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He doesn't move from the box. By dusk a pair of Kiln riders have taken the bend, and Ash is gone from it. Nobody will tell you how.","
","^A Kiln rider leans on the Yard gate and doesn't pay you. Kaplan asked for it to be clean, and clean didn't happen. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^They sit where Ash sat. They don't ask to see pins. They ask to see your cargo.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"warn":["ev","str","^ash","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You ride to the bend and tell Ash what both offers say. He listens without moving. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^Silver would send soldiers. Kaplan would send a rider who likes me. Neither one will ask twice. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He rolls the tin cup between his hands.","
","^I'll stay. A man can't hold a bend if he runs, and somebody has to look at the pins. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^You leave without the pay of either job.","
","end",null],"pins":["ev","str","^ash","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You hold out the money, and Ash doesn't take it at once. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^It'll go to the next driver who can't pay for his second pin. I'll write the name down. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He tucks it into the tin cup. The next truck stops at the bend, and he's crouched by its mount before you're out of sight.","
","^He doesn't mention Silver or Kaplan. He doesn't need to.","
","end",null],"bench":["^You carry a drill, a clamp and a bar of hull plate up the bend and set them on a flat rock in the shade of the wall. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^Ash watches without a word. A truck with a single pin rolls up and stops for him.","
","ev","str","^machining","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^bench","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You clamp the Nose ring and bore the second hole true to the first. You ream it and set a pin. The driver tries the lock twice and grins.","
","^The next truck is a Yard hauler with a Nose mount. Ash puts out his hand for the coin and gives it back, because the bench takes no fee.","
","^By dusk the road behind you is full of trucks that don't need a thumb on their pins. Silver can say nothing against a mount that holds. The Administrator loses a fee on every one. Ash loses his reason to sit here.","
","end",{"->":"bench.17"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You clamp the ring and bore the hole. It runs off the mark by a hair, and you don't see it.","
","^The truck rolls on. A little way up the bend the pin walks and the gun swings across the bed. The driver wrestles it back and curses your name at the top of his lungs.","
","^Ash climbs the road to find him and comes back with a new ring on his shoulder.","
","ev",{"x()":"money"},{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},{"x()":"pay","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The ring comes out of your pocket. ","ev",{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},"out","/ev","^ M goes into Ash's tin. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],"nop","
","^Ash takes the drill from the rock and puts it back in your truck.","
","^Look at pins, friend. Don't make them. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
",{"->":"road"},{"->":"bench.17"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"exposed":["^Sully Okafor listens with his back to the window and his coin still in his hand. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Crane office","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"scarf"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^exposed","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^yard","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"yard_power","re":true},"ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You lay the red scarf on his desk, and he flips it over. The edges are cut straight. It has never seen a day of wind.","
","^A pair of crane crews climb the bend before midnight. The crate is gone from the rocks when they reach them. The sergeant is standing by the bare stone, asking what they came for. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^They show him the scarf. He looks at it for a long moment and says nothing. Then he looks at you.","
","^Back in the crane office, Sully hangs the scarf in his window where the post can see it. ","#","^place: Crane office","/#","
","^I show what I'm given, and the captain will know whose hand gave it to me. I can't stop that, and I won't pretend I tried. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You tell him what you saw from the rise, and he hears it out without a word.","
","^A pair of crane crews climb the bend before midnight. When they reach the rocks there's only dust and stone.","
","^I can't show a soldier's shadow, friend. A story without a thing to hold is only weather. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","ev",{"x()":"money"},{"VAR?":"crew_fee"},">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"crew_fee"},{"x()":"pay","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^He charges for the crews and doesn't smile. ","ev",{"VAR?":"crew_fee"},"out","/ev","^ M goes onto his desk. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.16"},null]}],"nop","

","ev",{"VAR?":"scarf"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^hush","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^post","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"yard_power","re":true},"ev","str","^clean","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"silver_pay"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^You put the red scarf on his table. He looks at it for a long time. Then he opens the stove door and drops it in.","
","^The post keeps what the post keeps. You'll say nothing of this to anyone. The bend will stay as it is until I have need of it. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^He counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"silver_pay"},"out","/ev","^ M onto the table. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","end",{"->":"hush.13"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You tell him what you saw from the rise, and he hears you to the end.","
","^A story needs a thing to go with it. You've brought me only the story. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^He calls a soldier to walk you to the gate. The soldier writes your name in a small book as you go.","

facts.name: seen_ash
facts.text: North bend: Ash Kerimov stops every truck and asks to see its swivel pins.

facts.name: ash_story
facts.text: Ash: Emil Kessel died at this bend on a single pin. Ash pays for a second pin when a driver cannot. He rode for Scrapjaw once.

facts.name: heard_kaplan
facts.text: Kaplan: Kiln pays to see Ash gone from the bend. Kaplan asks that Ash be left alive.

facts.name: saw_rise
facts.text: The rise above the bend: a Nose cart left a crate of greased rifles in the rocks at dusk, with a bundle of Kiln red cloth on the lid.

facts.name: scarf
facts.text: You hold a Kiln red scarf, new and uncreased, from the crate.

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Bo. I drive a Granary truck. If you came for the story, sit down. Most do.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What happened near the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Are you a killer?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why did you sign the patrol roll?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tell me about the swivel.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where is Jens buried?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What of Jens's brother?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The Vosk brothers had been stopping trucks on the Nose road for a while. They always knew which ones. We carried a Brann swivel, and I had never fired at a man.","
","^They came out of the wreck rows. I swung the ring and I fired. Jens went down in the road.","
","^I stopped the truck. I went back to him. He was already gone.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^The tenant hall sat on it. They said a tenant who defends his load is not a killer. They were kind.","
","^I sat quiet. The hall can say what it likes. I know what my hand did.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^For the vote, mostly. Years yet to serve. I would be lying to say it was only that.","
","^A man on the road with a rifle should be a man who has thought about it. I have thought about it every night since.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Otto Brann's mount, from Ridge Wrecks. A ring of hull plate that swings across the bed. It locks with a pin.","
","^After that day Otto came and put a second pin on every swivel he had made. He did not say why. He did not need to.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Brother Anselm put him in the ground by Canyon Bridge. Across the road from Hal Sorensen, who died at the same trouble years before. Anselm lies there too now, between them.","
","^Lusa Fenwick reads their names at the bridge once a year. I go. I stay for all of it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Never caught. Some say he hid among the squatters at the convoy. Some say he rides for Kiln. I do not ask.","
","^If he came to my truck I would give him the grain and I would give him water. I would give him anything that bought Jens his life back.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

A scavenger came through a few days back, trying to sell a Nose Army radio. Said he pulled it off an Army wagon sitting dead in the hills north-east of here. When the Farmers asked him where, exactly, he filled his tank and left for Nose in a hurry."," ","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":[" ","^Every day. Traders, couriers, folk with a tank of fuel and a story. The ones that worry me are the quiet ones who ask where the seed stores are."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":[" ","^You know Glass Flats, out east? There is an Old World tank out there that still runs. Rolls out at night with its lights off. My cousin saw it. Well. Heard it."," ","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":[" ","^Soldiers playing at a town. They eat our grain and send us orders back. Polite enough, mind you, whenever they want something."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":[" ","^Pierce will not insure one without. The Granary arms its trucks. The Senate lets even tenants carry. And any welder can cut a mount from hull plate in a day."," ","^Ridge Wrecks does the finest, I hear. Otto Brann signs each one. A signed gun, think of that. Folk used to sign a loaf."," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":[" ","^Pim Arslan, the lens cutter, says every ripple in it leans one way. Toward the Fallen Sun. My cousin says it points at heaven. ",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Jory Baptiste. I speak for the tenants, which is to say I talk and the Senate nods off. Sit. The stool is free, which is more than the vote is.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^How does a tenant get a vote?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you fill the patrol with tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Does the patrol trouble you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Kiln and the grain?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is it true the top terraces draw water in secret?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who is Bo Lindqvist?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The ones who grow it. The citizens eat it. You can tell us apart by the dirt under the nails.","
","^We own less than Nose folk and answer to fewer. Poor but loose, like a dog off the chain.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Serve in the Bowl road patrol for a decade. Then the Senate lets you drop a pebble in a jar. My grandfather died one season short. Bad timing, but he was always a man of his own schedule.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Because the Senate wrote the rule, and I read it back to them slowly. They said service earns a vote. I send them the service.","
","^They let tenants carry rifles on the road now, and pay half the cost on grain runs. Nobody asked what a rifle in a tenant's hands might mean come voting day.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^They searched my house at night once. Looking for a rifle, they said. They found a spoon. I told them to keep it, I have more.","
","^They know my face now. Good. A man should be known by somebody.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^We pay Kiln and we pay the patrol, and we pay both with the same grain. A fine trick. The sack leaves once and the Senate counts it twice.","
","^Odile Marsh keeps the Granary count and writes it on the gate. Go read it. Both lines are our grain.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Say that in the market and they send for a meter. I will say it here. A pipe, they say, from the seep up to the top terraces. No meter allowed to read it.","
","^Have I seen it? I have seen the top terraces. Their kitchen gardens are very green for a dry year.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They ration everyone and call it kindness. A fed man in a line is still in a line.","
","^Ask me again in a famine. I may change my mind. I may not. I am a stubborn fellow when I am hungry.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A tenant who drives for the Granary. First of us to sign the patrol roll. Gentle as a tired ox.","
","^Do not joke with him about Jens Vosk. I joke about everything else, but I know where the edge is.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","^I read them all the same way, a robber beside a driver. The road doesn't sort them, so I don't try. facts.name: drunk_said
facts.text: Toll hut: a drunk man says Karl Vosk shot Hal Sorensen below the bridge, the year the road went unguarded.

facts.name: brass_held
facts.text: Spent brass from the drunk man: Old Army rifle, found on the road below the bridge the morning after Hal was shot.

facts.name: runner
facts.text: Toll hut: a wheel is burned into the heel of the drunk man's boot.

facts.name: book_seen
facts.text: Dario Feld's book, the day before: a pair of men in Army coats watched the trucks from the rise below the bridge. The younger had red thread at his cuff.

facts.name: hal_letter_read
facts.text: Hal's last letter: a stranger on the road offered him a rifle for grain, and he wouldn't pay for a thing he hadn't asked for.

facts.name: kiln_known
facts.text: Guild mail: a letter capped with a Burnt Convoy seal was addressed to Karl Vosk at Kiln Camp.

facts.name: office_files
facts.text: Pierce filing room: hook crates left by the north gate in Dell Marr's hand, week after week. His last line ends mid-word, and the pages after it are cut out.

facts.name: yard_tally
facts.text: Crane book: hook crates left the old yard by the north gate, week after week. Each line ends with a sealed order and one initial, L.

facts.name: otto_wheel
facts.text: Otto: he strapped the hook crates for the yard and signed each strap. The wheel crates went out roped.

facts.name: otto_lid
facts.text: Ridge Wrecks: a crate lid with a hook burned in, strapped with Otto's mark. Chalk on the edge says north gate, by L.

facts.name: mara_copy
facts.text: Mara Kessel's old case, second copy: the day each insured truck was filed at the Nose office and the night it was stopped on the road. The last line sends the clerk west, by order, L.

facts.name: caught
facts.text: Filing room: the clerk at the side table wrote a line when you took the book down.

","^Dust drifts across the hood. The other truck idles close, its driver a shape behind a screen.","

","^Grain from the Granary to wherever the Senate points. Every truck carries a gun now, on a ring pinned twice.","
","^The Granary pays a sack for each armed truck that crosses Kiln's road. A sack is cheaper than a truck.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Odile Marsh's counts. Sacks to Kiln. Tenants' shares for the patrol. She was a tenant once, and some of us still call her a turncoat behind her back.","

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Only the road near the walls. The Nose will not pay for the rest, and keeps its own. Between us there is nobody.","
","^So every truck is its own patrol. That is why we all carry a gun.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^I trust them to be Kiln. Pay and they let you through. Fight hard and they often let you through. Do neither and they strip you.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Good drivers. They sit at the back of the hall, and they do not complain. I have seen worse men with a vote.","

facts.name: lamps_seen
facts.text: Posts: every lamp is painted with a Pierce lien number. Under the flaking paint on one post an older number shows, in a thinner hand.

facts.name: juno_said
facts.text: Juno: she sells oil to the Bowl first and lights the lamps with what is left. The last lamp is resting, she says.

facts.name: tam_said
facts.text: Tam: the oil can is lighter every week. The last lamp is dry, and a Pierce tag is wired to its post.

facts.name: slip_read
facts.text: Carter's slip: the Granary pays for the oil, and the coin goes to a Pierce clerk. Juno's name is not on it.

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["

facts.name: log_read
facts.text: Gate log: every armed truck chalked as it crossed, and a sack owed to Kiln for each. Both columns agree.

facts.name: store_read
facts.text: Store book: more sacks left the store this week than the boards add up to.

facts.name: carter_said
facts.text: Carter: the collector at the drop keeps the tally on his own stick. The carters never see it.

facts.name: drop_seen
facts.text: Kiln drop: the collector notched his stick for sacks that never left a cart. A second wagon waits behind the rocks.

facts.name: weigher_said
facts.text: Night weigher: he signs sacks out after the sentry goes off. His cousin eats from the store.

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The canteen is empty. You shake it anyway. ","#","^place: The rim","/#","
","^Nothing slaps inside. The cap burns your fingers.","
","^Heat lifts off the rock in sheets. Your shirt dried on you hours ago.","
","ev","str","^Wipe your mouth.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tuck the canteen away.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^walk","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^Your lips are split. The back of your hand comes away gritty.","
",{"->":"rim"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^walk","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^It knocks against your hip as you walk. The sound is hollow.","
",{"->":"rim"},null]}],null],"rim":[["#","^checkpoint: rim","/#","^The rock ends. You stop at the edge. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Below you the land opens wide and flat and pale. Dust hangs over it like breath on glass.","
","^A thread of road runs through the dust. Far off, something stands up from the flat.","
","ev","str","^Look back the way you came.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Look down.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Only rock and the shimmer over it. Nothing there wants you back.","
",{"->":"slope"},null],"c-1":["
","^The slope is loose scree, a long way. Further down it is only dirt.","
",{"->":"slope"},null]}],null],"slope":[["#","^checkpoint: slope","/#","^You go down. Stones skate away from your boots. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The sun finds your neck and stays there. Sweat runs, then stops running.","
","^Your tongue is thick. Every breath tastes of dust.","
","ev","str","^Rest in the shade of a boulder.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Keep walking.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The shade is thin as paper. You count your breaths until they slow, then you make yourself stand.","
",{"->":"farm"},null],"c-1":["
","^You do not stop. Stopping feels like something you would not get up from.","
",{"->":"farm"},null]}],null],"farm":[["#","^checkpoint: farm","/#","^The thing on the flat is a water tower. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The farm","/#","
","^It stands alone, red with rust, its tank on thin legs. Under it lies a farm nobody tends.","
","^Fence posts lean. A house sits with its roof on its floor. A loose sheet of tin knocks in the wind.","
","ev","str","^Try the tap on the tower.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Call out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^It gives one cough and a thread of rust. Then nothing.","
",{"->":"shed"},null],"c-1":["
","^Your voice goes out and nothing sends it back.","
",{"->":"shed"},null]}],null],"shed":[["#","^checkpoint: shed","/#","^Behind the tower a shed has folded in on itself. ","#","^page","/#","
","^One wall leans on the other. Under the fallen roof sheet, something has wheels.","
","^An old pickup. Dust to the windows. The tires are soft but whole.","
","ev","str","^Pull the door open.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Wipe the glass first.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The hinge screams. A little cool air falls out of the cab.","
",{"->":"truck"},null],"c-1":["
","^Behind the dust, the seat is sprung and the dash is bare. The key is in it.","
",{"->":"truck"},null]}],null],"truck":[["#","^checkpoint: truck","/#","^The seat is hot and smells of oil and old rope. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The key is in the dash, as if the last hand only stepped out.","
","^You twist it. The starter grinds and quits.","
","^You twist it again. The engine catches for a breath and dies.","
","^The third time it starts. It coughs, misses, coughs again, and settles to a rough idle.","
","^The whole cab shakes. It runs.","
","ev","str","^Ease out of the shed.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^drive","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^The roof sheet scrapes along the cab. Then the light hits you, and the flat lies open all around.","
","end",null]}],null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Water drips somewhere close. It is the first sound that is not an engine. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^Your cheek rests on a cool plank. Light falls through holes in a roof of rusted sheet.","
","^A well mouth opens beside you, ringed with green moss. Your head throbs where the glass cut you.","
","ev","str","^Sit up.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^done","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^The room tilts and settles. Your truck stands in the dust outside the door, its engine cold.","
","^Whoever stopped you took what rode in the bed. Someone towed you here. Nobody left a name.","
",{"->":"hooks"},null]}],null],"hooks":[["^Rifles hang on iron hooks by the door, row on row, like coats. Nobody watches them. ","#","^page","/#","
","^A woman sets a tin cup on the plank beside you. She does not ask who you are.","
","^Drink. You are fed once under this roof. After that you pay like the rest. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^Hang your gun on a hook before you sit. That is all I ask. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","ev","str","^Drink.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The water is cold and tastes of stone. A bowl of hot grain follows it.","
","end",null]}],null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does the Bureau do?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who writes the gate law?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tell me about Emil Kessel.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Did a Pierce clerk go missing?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you carry to the Pierce office?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What about the depot business?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^We keep files. A file keeps a person. Do not ask me whose.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Command. No truck leaves Nose without a gun. The line hands each driver a steel mount with the gate pass. One pin. I have signed for every one.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^I filed it. Driver, north bend, mount slid, gun swung into the cab. Signed by a captain. Nobody wrote a word about the pin.","
","^His sister is at the Yard post now. Inspector Mara Kessel. She does not come to this corridor.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^I only say what the corridor says. A clerk at the Pierce office sold the roads of insured trucks to robbers. When it came out, he was sent west and told to stay.","
","^The Bureau had a case. The case is closed. I carry the box that closed it.","
","ev","str","^talkClerkWest","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^The Committee's account box, on market days. It goes in heavy and comes back lighter. I do not open it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The Pierce office at Nose is a narrow room with a high desk and a locked cabinet. The only chair in it stands on Constance Pierce's side. She doesn't rise when you come in, and she finishes adding her column before she looks up.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^proof","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The board has the file now, and my cousin hasn't spoken to me since. I call that a fair price for having it. I'll thank you once for the paper and I won't repeat myself. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^lucan","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^My cousin has a new clerk this month who does nothing I can see. I find myself wondering what the clerk is for. I also hear your name is written on a receipt in his book, and that interests me more than the clerk does. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^buried","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You told me nothing. I'll go on believing that for exactly as long as it stays believable. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^forged","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The board asked Otto Brann about a crate lid, and he told them he'd never seen it. I don't blame you for being useful. I do blame you for being careless. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^pierce","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You brought me a ring from the Yard, and I've written that down. I don't forget a favor, so you may take it that the account is open. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^State your business, please. Pierce charges by the quarter hour, and we write paper only on trucks with a gun on a proper mount. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why only trucks with a gun?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What makes a mount proper?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rule"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Where did all the rifles come from, if you don't ask?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rule"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^You look like someone with a problem.","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_guns"},{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I'm Constance Pierce, head underwriter at this office. I decide which trucks the company will bet on and what each bet costs. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^Augustin Pierce was my great-grandfather. I'd prefer you didn't use his name as a key, because it opens fewer doors than people think. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_rule","re":true},"^Because I wrote that rule, and I wrote it for arithmetic. A driver without a gun loses his load, and then we pay his family. A driver with a gun keeps it, or at least makes it expensive for whoever takes it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I don't claim it makes the road pleasant. I don't ask where the rifles came from, either. I ask only whether one is on the truck. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^It needs a pin on each side of the ring. A single pin can slide on a hard bend, and the gun swings round into the cab. Then we pay for a driver and a truck both. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^Nose issues its drivers a mount with one pin, so we write no paper on it. They pay the Salvage Yard to bore the second. That isn't my doing, and I don't stop it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_guns","re":true},"^The Old Army's, for the most part. The old Pierce yard held some of its trucks against a debt, and the guns left that yard in crates. I know that much because I've read the books. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I read the books before I trust any story about where a thing went. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^I have a cousin named Lucan, who runs this company. Before the yard went its own way, it crated the Army's guns for sale. Some crates were marked with a wheel on the lid, and some had a hook burned into it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^The wheel crates went to a dealer at the crossroads who sold to drivers. The hook crates went north. Scrapjaw has more rifles than the road ought to hold, and I can't prove who sent them. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I won't ask a clerk of mine to look, because every clerk in this building has a cousin. Find me a paper or a mark a board will read. And please don't say his name aloud in this room. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",["ev","str","^I'll look.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my business.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^cratesAsk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^I never forget a favor, and I never forgive a debt. Remember both, and you'll do well with me. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","ev","str","^crates_hook","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-1":["
","^Then we haven't spoken. You may leave the door as you found it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-5":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_rule"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_guns"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

He had never seen the Guild paint.","/#","#","^fact: read_rider South bend: the rider's swivel is bolted on but empty, and his hand shakes on the fender.","/#","

","^Tamsin Roe leans on the fender of a truck with a blue stripe down its door, reading a letter that isn't hers. ","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","^She folds it away when she sees you, without any hurry.","
","^You're the one the Guild sent? Good. I'm Tamsin. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^Vesna Hale rides behind me, always. She has the rifle and I have the wheel. But she's down with a fever, and the south loop won't wait for her. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^It's the Pump Station, South Lock, Green Pit and home. The Guild pays for the whole loop, and all I need is someone in the back seat. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^One thing first, though. I carry no gun. Not for you, not for Vesna, not for the Guild. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^You really carry no gun at all?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_gun"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^I'll ride behind you.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not this loop.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gun","re":true},"^I really don't. The Kiln riders know my truck, and they let it pass because it's unarmed. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^Besides, I read what people carry. In all the letters I've read, nobody ever wrote home that a gun made them braver. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"riding","re":true},"^Good. Go and see Vesna if you like, since she knows the road better than I do. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null],"c-2":["
","^Then Vesna goes out sick. You'd better tell her yourself, because I won't. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"post":[["#","^checkpoint: post","/#","^The bay smells of oil and cold tea. Tamsin checks the strap on the mail bag, then checks it again. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","ev","str","^See Vesna first.","/str",{"VAR?":"met_vesna"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask to see the mail bag.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ride out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"vesna"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"bag"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"road"},null]}],null],"vesna":[["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"met_vesna","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"vesna_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierVesna","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Vesna lies in a room above the radio shack with a blanket up to her chin and a rifle across the chair beside her. ","#","^place: Above the radio shack","/#","
","^She watches the window and not you. Her eyes go to the mirror on the wall every time a truck passes below.","
","^Kiln riders take the trucks that run alone. A new one has come to the south bend this season, and I never saw his face. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^I saw his truck from a long way off, though. It carried a Brann swivel, so he didn't build it himself. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^Tamsin thinks her blue paint is a wall. It's paint. Take the rifle. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^At Green Pit you'll want to hang it on the hook by Hadiza Okon's door before you drink. Everyone does, haulers and Kiln riders alike, and that's the only reason the well house stays peaceful. Bring it back to me afterward. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","ev","str","^Take Vesna's rifle.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Leave it with her.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"gun","re":true},"^She shuts her eyes. Her hand stays on the arm of the chair a moment after the rifle is gone.","
",{"->":"post"},null],"c-1":["
","^Then you ride bare, like Tamsin. I hope the paint is enough for you. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null]}],null],"bag":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_seen","re":true},"ev","str","^courierLetter","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tamsin loosens the strap and lets you look. ","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","^She carries other people's letters for free, and she reads every one of them. Most are small. A mother to a son at South Lock, a bill from a welder, and a note for the Pump Station with nothing on it but a date.","
","^One thick envelope is capped with a Burnt Convoy tin seal. It's addressed to Karl Vosk, care of Kiln Camp.","
","^Nobody writes to Kiln, so I'm carrying it myself. Someone wrote to him once, and that's all a letter ever tells you. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null],"road":["^Tamsin pushes the loop sheet across the hood. There's a line on it for the pair, and you scratch your name there because the Guild won't send a bag out without one. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Pump Station road","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Vesna's rifle lies across your knees. Tamsin doesn't look at it. ",{"->":"road.12"},null]}],"nop","
","^The road follows the old canal bank south, and dust hangs in the air all the way back to the hills.","
","^At the Pump Station Tamsin leaves the note with only a date on it. Agnes Ondra's meter board hangs by the door, and every line on it reads lower than last spring.","
",{"->":"lock"},null],"lock":[["^South Lock stands where the canal drops through its gates, and a man in a Bowl coat steps into the road with his hand up. ","#","^place: South Lock","/#","
","^He has a patrol badge and a worn letter in his other hand. Behind him Mirela Duarte sits at the lock house table with the Canal book open and does not look up.","
","^Morning, courier. The patrol's looking in every bag that goes south this season. Folks in Kiln have friends, and we'd like to know who writes to them. ","#","^speaker: Corporal","/#","
","^He says it kindly, which makes it worse. Tamsin keeps both hands on the wheel.","
","^The Guild doesn't open a bag for anyone. I'd sooner lose the road. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","ev","str","^Let Tamsin hold her ground.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Talk to the corporal.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Slip the thick letter into the door panel.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell Tamsin to show him the bag.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_refused"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_talk"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_hide"},null],"c-3":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_read"},null]}],{"lock_refused":["ev","str","^refused","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^Tamsin says it again, slowly, and the corporal looks at her for a long moment. ","#","^place: South Lock","/#","
","^Then he lowers his hand and steps aside. The Guild's been good to my mother, he says, and I'd sooner not be the one who stops it.","
","^The word will still reach the toll hut that a Guild truck wouldn't be looked into. Bowl remembers a closed bag.","
",{"->":"green"},null],"lock_talk":["ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^talked","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^You ask him about the letter in his hand, and he tells you it's from his mother, who lives on a farm below the Granary. You tell him what a mother wants a courier to carry, and that the bag is full of letters just like his.","
","^He laughs and waves you on. Nothing in a mother's bag would help Kiln, he says.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^You talk, but you talk like a man hiding something. The corporal's eyes go to the bag.","
","^Sorry, courier. I'll have to look after all. ","#","^speaker: Corporal","/#","
","^He opens the strap himself. The thick envelope with the Burnt Convoy seal is on top, and he reads the address aloud, twice, as if he were memorizing it.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"lock_hide":["ev","str","^machining","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^hidden","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^While Tamsin argues about the Guild's rules, you pry the inside panel from the door with a fingernail and push the thick letter into the gap. The panel snaps back flat.","
","^The corporal searches the bag and finds a mother's letter, a welder's bill and a date. He lets you through, a little ashamed.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^You pry at the panel, and the clip snaps with a crack that carries across the lock. The corporal looks round.","
","^The letter is lying on the floor of the cab with the Burnt Convoy seal facing up. He picks it up and reads the address, and he gives it back with great care.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"lock_read":["ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^Tamsin stares at you. Then she hands the bag down without a word. ","#","^place: South Lock","/#","
","^The corporal goes through it as kindly as he does everything. He stops at the thick envelope and reads the address.","
","^Karl Vosk, at Kiln. He says the name twice. I thank you, he says. The patrol's been asking after that name for a long time.","
",{"->":"green"},null]}],"green":[["#","^checkpoint: green","/#","^Green Pit lies in a dip, a well under a roof and an inn built around it. Rifles hang on iron hooks by the door, because at Hadiza Okon's well house everyone hangs their gun before they drink. That's how raiders and haulers share one room. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev","str","^green-pit","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You know this place. Hadiza Okon fills the cups herself, as before. ",{"->":".^.^.^.19"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ A cracked pit with a roof over the well. Hadiza Okon fills the cups herself, and nobody argues with the hooks. ",{"->":".^.^.^.19"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^Hang Vesna's rifle on a hook, like everyone.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Keep the rifle on your shoulder.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Sit down with Tamsin.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"drinkers_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierRider","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The tables go on talking. A hauler says the new Kiln rider sat here last week with his coat buttoned to the neck, and he left his rifle on his truck.","
","^He asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the blue stripe.","
","^Tamsin sets down her cup. She doesn't say anything.","
",{"->":"bend"},null],"c-1":["
","^The talk at the tables stops when you pass. Hadiza Okon looks at the empty hook, then at you, and fills Tamsin's cup first.","
","^Nobody tells you anything. Tamsin drinks standing.","
",{"->":"bend"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"drinkers_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierRider","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A hauler says the new Kiln rider sat here last week with his coat buttoned to the neck, and he left his rifle on his truck.","
","^He asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the blue stripe.","
","^Tamsin sets down her cup. She doesn't say anything.","
",{"->":"bend"},null]}],null],"bend":[["#","^checkpoint: bend","/#","^South of the pit the road climbs to a bend between rock shoulders. One truck stands crosswise on the rise with a Brann swivel bolted to its bed. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^The rider on it is alone. He wears an Army coat, and the cuff is stitched with red thread.","
","^Tamsin stops the truck and keeps both hands on the wheel.","
","^Courier. Guild paint. You know it. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^He doesn't answer. He has never seen the paint.","
","ev","str","^Tell Tamsin to hand over the thick letter.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Raise Vesna's rifle.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Pay the rider ","ev",{"VAR?":"toll"},"out","/ev","^ M. ","#","^cost: ","ev",{"VAR?":"toll"},"out","/ev","/#","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Look hard at the rider.","/str",{"VAR?":"read_rider"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask Tamsin to let you take the wheel.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^Let Tamsin talk.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["

",{"->":"toll_paid"},null],"c-3":["

",{"->":"wheel"},null],"c-5":["
",{"->":"stripped"},null]}],null],"letter":["ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"ev","str","^delivered","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^courierKarl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tamsin reaches into the bag without looking and holds out the thick letter. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^The rider reads the seal first. Then he sits on his fender and reads the page slowly, with his lips moving.","
","^When he stands, his face has changed. He's younger than his coat.","
","^Tell Sefa I eat. Tell her I ride. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^He waves you through, and he's still sitting on the fender when the bend is behind you.","
",{"->":"home"},null],"toll_paid":["ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"^The rider takes the coins and counts them twice. He doesn't ask what the bag carries. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^He drags his truck off the road by a length. Tamsin drives on with her eyes on the mirror.","
",{"->":"home"},null],"reading":["ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"read_rider","re":true},"^The rider's swivel is bolted to his bed, but no belt hangs from it and no round sits in the chamber. His hand shakes on the fender, and the red thread on his cuff has been mended more than once. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^He is alone because nobody else would stand there. You say so, in a low voice, and you say that whoever stitched that cuff is worried about him.","
","^He stares at you. Then his shoulders drop.","
","^I'm not supposed to do this alone. Go on, then. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"^He drags his truck off the road. Tamsin drives through without a word.","
",{"->":"home"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You study him and see an Army coat and a gun. You say something to him about his cuff, and it comes out like a threat.","
","^His face goes white and then red. He whistles twice.","
",{"->":"stripped"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"wheel":["ev","str","^driving","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"ev","str","^ran","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"courier_fate","re":true},"^Tamsin looks at you for a heartbeat. Then she slides across the seat. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^You put the truck at the shoulder, where the rock falls away in a slope of loose shale, and you keep the wheels on the ledge. The rider's swivel swings after you and finds nothing.","
","^Behind you he fires a shot into the air. Nobody follows. Tamsin says nothing for the next mile, and then she laughs once.","
",{"->":"home"},{"->":"wheel.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Tamsin slides across the seat. You take the shoulder at speed, and the shale slides out from under the rear wheels. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^The truck ends in the ditch with its nose in the rock. The mail bag is on the rise, and the rider is already walking toward it.","
",{"->":"stripped"},{"->":"wheel.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"armed":["ev","str","^armed","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"ev","str","^armed","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"courier_fate","re":true},"^You bring Vesna's rifle up over the cab. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^The rider looks at the muzzle, then at the swivel on his own bed, which he hasn't touched.","
","^He backs his truck off the road by a length. Nobody fires.","
","^Tamsin drives through without a word. She doesn't look at the rifle on your knees.","
",{"->":"home"},null],"stripped":["ev","str","^stripped","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"ev","str","^stripped","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"courier_fate","re":true},"^Tamsin talks. She names the Guild, the blue stripe and the riders who know her. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^It does nothing. More trucks come over the rise behind you.","
","^They take the mail bag, the fuel can and the spare water.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ They take Vesna's rifle from your knees, and they take it gently. ",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","

","ev",{"VAR?":"lost_share"},{"x()":"pay","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A rider goes through your pockets and leaves you less. ","ev",{"VAR?":"lost_share"},"out","/ev","^ M is gone. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.33"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"home"},null],"home":["^Nose lies under its smoke at dusk. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","^Vesna sits at the top of the stairs in her blanket. She has watched the road since noon.","
","^The loop sheet lies on the post desk. Under the line for the pair, Tamsin has written your name in her round hand. Beside the bag line she has written nothing. A copy of the sheet goes to the Guild board, and the board sells what it holds.","
",["ev",{"VAR?":"result"},"str","^stripped","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Tamsin carries what is left of the truck inside. The Guild writes the loop off.","
","^Vesna looks at your empty hands. ","ev",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ That was my father's rifle. She says it once, quietly. ",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ She says nothing. ",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
","end",{"->":"home.15"},null]}],["ev",{"VAR?":"result"},"str","^armed","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"reward"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Vesna takes her rifle back and checks it. Tamsin pays you at the bay door and doesn't look up while she counts out ","ev",{"VAR?":"reward"},"out","/ev","^ M. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^I said no gun. Now Kiln's seen one on a Guild truck. I'll ride with Vesna again, but not behind a gun I didn't choose. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","end",{"->":"home.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"reward"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Vesna takes her rifle back and checks it. She finds it as she left it. ",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","^The Guild pays ","ev",{"VAR?":"reward"},"out","/ev","^ M for the loop. Vesna looks at the stripe on the truck and says it's still only paint. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","

facts.name: vesna_said
facts.text: Vesna: a new rider holds the south bend this season. His truck carries a Brann swivel.

facts.name: letter_seen
facts.text: Mail bag: a thick letter capped with a Burnt Convoy tin seal, addressed to Karl Vosk, care of Kiln Camp.

facts.name: drinkers_said
facts.text: Green Pit tables: the new Kiln rider asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the Guild paint.

facts.name: read_rider
facts.text: South bend: the rider's swivel is bolted on but empty, and his hand shakes on the fender.

facts.name: ledger_read
facts.text: Ledger: cans went missing on the third, seventh and eleventh nights. Pell was on duty each time.

facts.name: gate_checked
facts.text: Gate log: Corporal Vance signed out late on the third, seventh and eleventh nights, alone, with an empty truck bed.

facts.name: saw_swap
facts.text: Fuel shed: Vance asked Pell to swap shifts tonight. Pell agreed without looking up. Vance has a scar across his chin.

facts.name: knows_scar
facts.text: Sabine: a corporal brings her the cans. Big hands, a scar across the chin. Never a name.

facts.name: found_seals
facts.text: Barracks: a tin of Army fuel seals under Vance's cot, cut clean.

facts.name: saw_handoff
facts.text: Back fence: at dawn Vance passed cans over the wire to a truck with Sabine's mark.

","^A tone comes out of the central hull. It repeats a number, and the number grows by one each year. The tower has listened since my great-grandfather's day.","
","^We think it counts the years since the fall. This year's number hangs by the tower door, in my hand.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^A number kept in one head is a number kept from everyone. We voted on it, and I spoke first.","
","^Teo would not agree. He had kept it close since he was young. The Society cast him out.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Teo took the tower when my great-grandfather died of burns. He read the plate when nobody else could. He read the count to me at the crater rim and told me to keep reading it after him.","
","^People call him the Apprentice now. I do not. He was never anyone's apprentice but the sky's.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^A number. It is larger than this year's. I believe it is where the count stops.","
","^I do not know how they came to it. Someone must have read further than we have.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardNumber","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^I do not know. Nobody does. Anyone who says he knows is selling something.","
","^I read it anyway. A thing not read is a thing that happens to you.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The Sunward closed it to us after the vote. Their Preacher says we count their god's patience. I would call that fair, if I believed in the god.","
","^We read from the tower now, and from here. The glow does not mind.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Half the old families here have a grandmother who woke in a pod. They ask the count more than anyone. They want to know how long they have been waiting.","
","^I tell them the number. They nod. Some of them say a word in the old tongue.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: wall_read
facts.text: Blockhouse wall: coats of paint, one number over another. This morning's number is one short of the last.

facts.name: gap_seen
facts.text: Motor pool: an empty slot at the end of the third row. The chocks are still in place and the ground under it is swept.

facts.name: ilya_said
facts.text: Ilya: the gate was shut all night and he slept in the blockhouse. He has counted every dawn and never been wrong.

facts.name: stub_read
facts.text: Gate stub book: at dusk a Pierce cart passed the gate with a release paper for one truck.

facts.name: release_read
facts.text: Release paper: the Pierce lien number matches the one on the chocks of the empty slot. The seal of the Archon's household is on it.

facts.name: saw_cut
facts.text: North bend: Emil's wreck is bare. The ring under the gun was torched off at the base, and the bolts still stand in the bed.

facts.name: boots
facts.text: North bend: the boot prints of soldiers lie under the stripper's tracks.

facts.name: yard_tally
facts.text: Yard tally: a Nose steel ring, torch cut, bought as scrap the week Emil died and sold on to a Kiln hauler.

facts.name: otto_read
facts.text: Otto: a Nose ring carries the gate stamp on its flat and a single pin hole. A Brann ring has a small mark and a second pin hole.

facts.name: saw_roster
facts.text: Crane office: Captain Silver's patrol roster lies in a drawer, copied twice in one small hand. The corner of one copy says M. Kessel.

facts.name: post_ahead
facts.text: Yard tally: a Nose soldier stood at the end of the bench and wrote nothing.

facts.name: has_ring
facts.text: Kiln: the ring with the gate stamp and a single pin hole.

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Pump book: a pipe to the Archon's terrace draws seep water every week. No meter reads it.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Household: a steward in a Marr coat offered coin to lose the bundle on the road.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Canal book: the same weekly line for the pipe, in Mirela's hand.

facts.name: report_named
facts.text: South Lock: Tomas Duarte wrote a patrol report on the valve. It lies on the Archon's desk.

","^Pim Arslan sits behind a plank counter with a diamond saw and a heap of dark glass, and the saw whines every time she touches a lump of it. She holds a lens up to the sun and squints through it before she looks at you. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard stalls","/#","
","^Glass from the Flats. It cuts the glare and shows what the glare hides, which is more useful than it sounds. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^She sets the lens down and rubs her thumb on her apron, as if the glass had left something there.","
","^I've a favor to ask of somebody who doesn't look like anybody. I haven't found such a person yet. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Buy a smoke lens. ","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"lens_held","re":true},"^She wraps it in a rag and sets it in your hand. It's cool and heavier than it looks.","
","^Look through it before you decide what you see. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","

","end",null]}],null]}],"errand":[["^Pim lowers her voice, though only the stalls are listening. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard stalls","/#","
","^It's about Hadiza Okon, who keeps the well and the inn at Green Pit. She feeds anyone once, and she has a rule at her door. Everybody hangs their rifle on a hook by the threshold before they drink, so that raiders, haulers and Yard crews can share one room without a gun in it. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^A Nose soldier from Silver's post sits by those hooks now. He's polite, and he writes. Hadiza wants to know what he writes and who reads it, and she asked me for someone she doesn't know. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^You're nobody she knows. I scratched the lean lines of the Flats' glass on a plate and hung it by her door, so she'll listen if you say I sent you. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","ev","str","^I'll go to Green Pit.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my fight.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^hooksSoldier","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tell her I sent you. And hang your rifle on the hook, because nobody drinks there with it on. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
",{"->":"arrive"},null],"c-1":["
","^Then drink somewhere else. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","end",null]}],null],"arrive":["^Green Pit lies in a dip, a well under a roof and an inn built around it, and the air smells of cold water and woodsmoke. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^Rifles hang on the iron hooks by the door, many of them, like coats in a hall. A scratched plate hangs beside them, and every line on it leans the same way.","
","ev","str","^green-pit","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You know the place. ",{"->":"arrive.18"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ The well drops a hand's width when the year is dry. Nobody here says so out loud. ",{"->":"arrive.18"},null]}],"nop","
","^Hadiza Okon fills a cup before you speak.","
","^Hang it on the hook. Everyone drinks here, and nobody takes my well. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^Her chin points at a young man in a Nose coat on a stool by the hooks. He has a sheet on a board across his knees.","
","^That's the soldier. He came with the dry year. He sits, he watches, and he writes. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^I feed him once a day, same as anyone. I want to know what he writes and who reads it. Then I want you to tell me what I should do about it. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
",{"->":"hooks"},null],"hooks":[["#","^checkpoint: hooks","/#","^The soldier doesn't look up. Water drips behind the roof, and now and then a rifle clinks on its hook. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","

","^You hold the dark glass to your eye, and the soldier becomes a shape on a stool with the light carved out of his edges.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You look at nothing in particular and watch him from the edge of your eye, the way a hunter watches a bird.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
","^A hauler hangs a rifle. The soldier doesn't move his head, but his pencil moves.","
","^A Kiln rider hangs one, and the pencil moves again. A welder from the Yard comes next, then another rider, and the pencil keeps pace.","
","^He never looks at the faces. He looks at the stocks, at the stamp cut into the wood, a wheel or a hook. He writes the stamp, and then he writes who hung it.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"watch.17"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You stare at the soldier for far too long. He lifts his head, meets your eyes and writes a line on his sheet.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^He doesn't say a word, but the pencil has got your face now.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"watch.17"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"drinkers":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_drinkers","re":true},"^The tables go quiet when you ask, then loosen. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^He asks nothing. He only counts. ","#","^speaker: Kiln rider","/#","
","^He counted my crew when I was here with the Yard. Names, I think. I don't like my name written down. ","#","^speaker: Yard welder","/#","
","^Hadiza doesn't like it either. She says so with the soup. ","#","^speaker: Kiln rider","/#","
",{"->":"hooks"},null],"soldier":["^You sit down beside him. He moves the board a hand's width away and says nothing for a while. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"soldier_talked","re":true},"^You ask him how his week has been. You ask where he's from and whether his mother knows where he sits. He answers the first, then the second, and then his shoulders drop.","
","^I count. I write what I count. The sergeant takes the sheet at the week's end, and the clerk takes it from the sergeant. I don't know what the clerk does with it. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^Hadiza feeds me once a day, and I eat all of it. I'm sorry for what I write. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He looks at the hooks, not at you.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"soldier_shut","re":true},"^You ask what he writes. He closes the board against his chest.","
","^I count. That's all, and I'm not to say more. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He watches you for the rest of the evening, and he writes when you reach for your cup.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"hooks"},{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","

","^Hadiza brings the soldier a bowl and talks about the well. He sets the board down on his knee to take it. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^You have the sheet in your hands for as long as it takes to read it.","

","^Wheel; Yard welder ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every line names a face. The Yard welders and the Kiln riders hang side by side on each one.","
","^You put it back as you found it.","

","^You keep a long way behind, using the dust of other trucks and the dips in the road. He never looks in his mirror.","
","^The Yard crane stands over the stacked wrecks. Silver's post sits inside the gate, a Nose flag over a tin roof.","
","^The soldier hands the sheet to a clerk. The clerk doesn't read it. He pins it to a board by the captain's door.","
","^A second hand has inked a line under it. Yard crews drink with raiders. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^The line is in better ink than the sheet.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"follow.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You stay too close. At the first long straight the soldier's mirror catches your grille.","
","^He stops and gets out. Without a word he writes down the number of your truck, and then he drives on.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"follow.15"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"decide":[["^Hadiza stands in the doorway of the inn with a cup in her hand, waiting. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^The soldier writes the marks and the faces, and the captain's clerk adds the rest. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"read_tally"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You read his sheet. It names who hangs beside whom. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza ",{"->":".^.^.^.17"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","^Tell me what I do. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","ev","str","^Tell her all of it and let her settle it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Pay the soldier to write the marks and leave out the faces.
