","^You tell Hadiza everything: the marks, the faces, the clerk's second hand and the captain's door. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"read_tally"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You tell her about the plate and the glass cutter's line. She says Pim's name softly, once, and does not say it again. ",{"->":"told.27"},null]}],"nop","
","^She says nothing until you finish. Then she sets the cup down and goes to the soldier.","
","^She feeds him at her own table, a full meal, with a cup of the good water.","
","^Eat. Then write the stamps. The faces are mine. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^He lowers his eyes and nods. She doesn't ask whether he means it.","
","^She counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M into your hand for the telling. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^The hooks go on holding the rifles. Nobody can say how many sheets reach the captain with faces on them.","
","end",null],"bought":["ev","str","^bought","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^bought","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"^You take the soldier aside behind the inn and put ","ev",{"VAR?":"bribe"},"out","/ev","^ M in his hand. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^He looks at the coins, then at the hooks, then at you. He is quiet for a long time.","
","^I write the stamps. I don't write faces. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He tucks the money inside his coat.","
","^The sheets go to the captain thinner after that. The clerk's second hand has less to ink under them.","
","^Hadiza says nothing to you. She fills your cup, which is as much as she says to anyone.","
","end",null],"turned":["ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^turned","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^turned","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"^You find the soldier alone by the well and speak to him as one man speaks to another who was handed a pencil. You tell him what the faces on his sheet are used for, and what Hadiza has fed him.","
","^He's quiet for a while. Then he draws a line down the margin of his board and writes only the stamp column.","
","^They'll send another, you know. But for as long as it's me, I'll write what I'm told and not what I could. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^Hadiza fills your cup when you come in, which is the way she says thanks.","
","end",{"->":"turned.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You find the soldier alone by the well and speak to him badly. He listens to the end, white-faced, and he says nothing back.","
","^The sheet that reaches the clerk that week has a new line under Hadiza's door. The Yard welders are underlined, and a stranger who talks to the soldier is named at the bottom.","
","^Hadiza fills your cup last.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"turned.10"},null]}],"nop","

Every stamp, every face, every line of the clerk's second hand. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^The inn goes still. A Kiln rider takes his rifle off the hook and doesn't put it back.","
","^The Yard welders look at each other. A hauler laughs, then stops.","
","^By midnight the benches are half empty. Rifles leave the hooks in ones and pairs. Nobody argues, and nobody sits.","
","^Hadiza fills your cup last.","
","^I asked you to find out. I didn't ask you to say it. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^The soldier sits on his stool until dawn with his board on his knees. Nobody comes to eat with him.","

He listens with the coin still in his hand. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Crane office","/#","
","^He asks you to say the line again. You say it, and he writes it down.","
","^Yard crews drink with raiders. A fine charge, friend, for a post that has been drinking from the Yard's well for a year. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","^I'll put it in front of the Committee in Nose. They owe Pierce more than they owe me, and they hate being asked what a soldier is doing with a pencil. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","^He doesn't say whose name will go beside the line.","
","end",null],"after_hooks":["^Pim is cutting a lens at her plank counter. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard stalls","/#","

","^She says the Administrator has a page on his desk with a line in better ink. She hasn't been to Green Pit since.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"lens_held"},false,{"VAR=":"saw_hooks"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_drinkers"},false,{"VAR=":"read_tally"},false,{"VAR=":"saw_drop"},false,{"VAR=":"soldier_talked"},false,{"VAR=":"soldier_shut"},15,{"VAR=":"lens_price"},40,{"VAR=":"bribe"},20,{"VAR=":"fee"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"outcome"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: saw_hooks
facts.text: By the hooks, through the smoke glass: the soldier marks each hung rifle by its stock stamp, wheel or hook, and by the hand that hung it.

facts.name: asked_drinkers
facts.text: Green Pit tables: a Kiln rider says the soldier asks nothing and only counts. A Yard welder says he counted her crew too.

facts.name: read_tally
facts.text: His sheet: a column of faces and stamps. Yard crews sit beside Kiln riders on every line, and the glass cutter from the Yard stalls is on one.

facts.name: saw_drop
facts.text: Silver's post, inside the Yard: a clerk pins the sheet by the captain's door and inks a line under it. Yard crews drink with raiders.

facts.name: soldier_talked
facts.text: The soldier: the sergeant takes his sheet each week, and the clerk takes it from the sergeant.

yard_mara.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The desk at the post gate stands empty, and the ink on the blotter has dried to a grey skin. A clerk says that Mara Kessel sits in the post cell and that nobody may visit her.","
",{"->":"start.gone"},{"->":"start.11"},null]}],"nop","
","^Mara Kessel sits at a desk by the post gate with a pair of ledgers open in front of her. She writes a line in one and copies it with great care into the other. She doesn't look up until you're standing at the edge of the blotter.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^mara","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The ring is where it ought to be. I'd rather not say where, since you're exactly the person who might be asked. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The yard forge ran hot all night. I smelled it from this desk, and I won't pretend I don't know what went into it. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^sully","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear the crane office has a new object in one of its drawers. That pleases me more than I can show on this side of the gate. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pierce","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^A clerk from the Pierce office came to this gate yesterday. He asked me very politely for my brother's full name, and I gave it to him without asking why. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Please keep your voice down. The captain hears a great deal for a man who seems to be reading. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you write everything twice?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What happened to your brother?","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_emil"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why would Nose issue a mount with one pin?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_pin"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who at Pierce would care about a ring like this?","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^mara","/str","==",{"VAR?":"heard_pierce"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What will you do with the pages I signed?","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^signed","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the post know my name?","/str",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Constance Pierce has proof against her cousin.","/str",{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"str","^proof","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^You look like someone with a problem.","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_emil"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_emil","re":true},"^I'm Mara Kessel, and I used to be an inspector of the Order Bureau. That's the office Nose uses to look into its own officials. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^These days I count patrols for Captain Silver, which Nose calls a posting. My brother Emil drove the north road before I came here, and that's why I sit at this desk and not another. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Because a page can be lost. I learned in the Bureau that a page and its copy have to be lost separately, by different people, before anything is truly gone. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pin","re":true},"^He died on the north bend last winter. His gun came round on its ring and into his cab, because the pin that should have held it slid on the curve. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^The ring that carries the gun is called a swivel. Emil's had a single pin, where a safe one has a pin on each side, and Nose issued it to him that way with his gate pass. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pierce","re":true},"^To save steel, I'd guess, and an hour of a machinist's time. The line copies a better mount and leaves out whatever is cheap to leave out. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^Pierce, the company that insures salvage runs, won't write paper on a one-pin mount. But Nose drivers don't buy Pierce paper. They buy a gate pass, and the Yard bores the second pin for a fee if they can afford it. Emil couldn't, not before payday. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Constance Pierce, the head underwriter at their office in Nose. She reads every file that crosses her desk, and she's never read one by accident. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^If you go to her, ask who read my old case. Then watch her face before she answers. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Keep them dry, mostly. A page with a witness is worth a great many without one. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^My old case has a second copy in the same drawer. If you ever need to read it, tell the Administrator I said you may. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^It does. The captain keeps a file on everyone who passes his gate, and yours is thicker than it was last week. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I didn't write the new lines in it, and I'd very much like to know who did. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Then the Pierce board is holding my old case under another name. That's fine. A true thing can wear a great many names and still be true. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^There's one thing. When Emil's truck was found, the swivel was still bolted to the bed. By the time anyone from the post rode out there, it had been stripped, as wrecks on the north road usually are. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I'd like the ring that held his gun, the Nose steel one with the single pin hole in it. I can't stop thinking about it. I want to hold it in my own hands. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I can't go myself, because the captain reads the gate book every morning and an officer of his post doesn't leave it. I also don't like to ask favors of anyone who owes the post something, and you owe it nothing. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",["ev","str","^I'll find it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my road.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Thank you. Please tell nobody at the post, not even the soldiers who seem friendly. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","ev","str","^pin_emil","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-1":["
","^I understand. I wouldn't have asked if I could do it myself. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null],"gone":[["#","^checkpoint: start.gone","/#","ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"knows_emil"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_pin"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_pierce"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

yard_sefa.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sefa Krol. I trade for the families of the Burnt Convoy. Show me what you carry and I will tell you what it is worth. Keep your hand off my table.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the families of the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you sell here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you never take the last water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Burnt Convoy picked clean?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is it with the debtor book?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is your deal with Kiln?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},"ev","str","^Did you hide a robber once?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of Pierce and the guns?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of the post at the gate?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^People who live where the road stopped. We are not a camp. A camp has a flag and a man who wants to be called sir.","
","^We are first to any wreck, and last to leave it. That is all we are.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^What the road is done with. Wiring, wheel rims, a gun with no pin. Things that have a second life if you are not proud.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^A man with no water is a body, and a body is trouble. Leave him his water and he is a fool who walks on. Fools talk less than bodies.","
","^Also, my mother would find out. She finds out everything.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Who says that? Ibo says it, on the air, to men who would not drive out there for a gift. Good. Let him.","
","^We pick it every week and the road leaves more. Rust grows new things. Ask any family.","
","ev","str","^talkConvoyNotClean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^We stopped a Pierce office truck on the road and took a book off the seat. Page after page of names and sums. Sums I cannot read, the zeroes go on so long.","
","^The Yard could read them. I sold it to them. What it says is not for sale, and what the Yard does with it is not my business.","
","^A crane office has a shut door now, and a shut door is a loud thing.","
","ev","str","^talkCraneBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Kiln has a man named Kaplan who knows a fair split. What Kiln riders leave on the road is ours. What we find of their dead we bury with their boots on.","
","^It is a good arrangement. Nobody on either side likes it, which is how you know it works.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Men come to the convoy with nothing. We ask nothing. One came after his brother died in the road. He ate our beans for a long time and spoke little. Then he went south.","
","^I will not say his name. It would be rude to the beans.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^I hear that Pierce sold the Old Army's guns north to Scrapjaw, and then made every driver buy a gun to get paper. I hear it from a pair of drivers who each swear the other lied.","
","^Good business, if it is true. A man who sells the fire and the bucket never starves.","
","ev","str","^talkPierceGuns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Nose soldiers inside a free yard. Mara Kessel writes down who comes and goes. She writes it twice. A woman who writes twice is afraid of something.","
","^We keep to the north side. Soldiers do not like the wind there.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

yard_silver.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Captain Silver stands at the post gate with his hands clasped behind his back. He's watching the road through the gate as if it owed him something, and he looks round only when your shadow reaches his boots.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^signed","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A single ledger lies open on a table behind him, and a page in it carries your name. ",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A single ledger lies open on a table behind him. ",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"bend_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The north bend is quiet now, and my drivers pass it without trouble. I'd prefer you didn't wait for me to thank you. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^kiln","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear a pair of Kiln riders have been sitting at the north bend all week. Either you did that or you let it be done, and I'll remember which. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^ash","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The man at the north bend still stops my drivers and tells them their mounts are bad. I'm told you were standing next to him when he started again. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bench","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear a bench stands at the north bend now, boring second pins for anyone who drives up. My soldiers have orders to leave it alone. That order lasts as long as I say it does. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^exposed","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^A scrap of Kiln red cloth hangs in the window of the crane office, and the Administrator shows it to anyone who asks. I know whose hand carried it to him. I don't forget hands. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^hush","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^We have an understanding about the north bend, you and I. I'd advise you to keep it exactly as it is. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The ring is ash and the page is filed. That's how I like a matter to end. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^sully","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I'm told the crane office keeps a ring in a locked drawer. A ring can be carried out of a drawer, Driver, and a drawer can be opened by more than one key. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^State your business, and make it brief. The road doesn't guard itself. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is your post doing here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Nose mount safe?","/str","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"str","^pinStamp","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who bores the second pin into a Nose mount?","/str","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"str","^pinStamp","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^The Yard gate seems to answer to your sergeant now.","/str",{"VAR?":"yard_power"},"str","^post","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^The crane hands stand very close to your gate.","/str",{"VAR?":"yard_power"},"str","^yard","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is my name in your file?","/str",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is there work for me?","/str",{"VAR?":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^It keeps the Yard safe for honest haulers. The repair crews are skilled with a torch, but they can't hold a gate against raiders. My soldiers can. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Yes. It's cast steel, it swings and it locks. A driver who knows his mount has no trouble with it. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^When a driver does have trouble, it's almost always because he didn't look after what the line gave him. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Yard does, for a fee, and the Administrator sets the fee. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^A man who sells a second hole to drivers the line sent out with one is a man who profits from the one. You might ask yourself whether he wants the line to mend its mounts. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It answers to order. The crews are learning quickly what order costs and what it buys. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^They do. A yard that thinks itself free forgets who sent its fuel through this gate last winter. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Every name that crosses my gate is in my file. Some of them are in a second file, and that one is thicker. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I've no work for you, but I do have a file with your name in it. A man sits on the north bend and stops my drivers to look at their pins. Move him, and I'll shorten that file. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^A man sits on the north bend and stops my drivers. He makes them show him their swivel pins and tells them our mounts are bad. That's a fine thing to hear before a long drive. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^A post can't run on talk, so I want him off that bend. How you manage it is your business. I'll pay when it's done. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",["ev","str","^I'll see him.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my kind of work.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^bendOffers","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Don't bring me excuses, Driver. I've a drawer full of those already. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","ev","str","^bend_north","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-1":["
